decision.observation: 0 mph, gear 1, timer 37:17.149, dots pale, no red X. The car is off the gravel on the right-hand grass, wedged among pine trunks, nose up-frame. The road runs along the left/lower-left of frame; the red/white striped hut with white fence is at the right.
decision.hypothesis: The W+A beat at 11 mph carried the car through the left bend and off the outside onto the grass, then a trunk stopped it. Road lies left and down-frame relative to the nose, so reversing (which moves the car opposite the nose, down-frame) with A to swing the nose left should put it back on the gravel aimed along the road.
decision.memory: Even a well-placed inside-line entry at 11 mph with a 0.5 s left beat ended off-road; left bends at 11 mph may need a shorter beat or a lower entry speed. The red/white striped hut is now clearly a trackside shelter, not a gate.
